subject: P11 auth-read-connection surgical controls

case_matrix.property: Warmed auth connection observes peer committed replacements
case_matrix.mechanism: Real two-store SQLite; A holds BEGIN IMMEDIATE root, B starts outside its ALS, root still reads original bytes and snapshots, root releases, await B COMMIT, A reads new bytes both directly and in a new canonical root; another replacement is also observed.

case_matrix.property: Managed parent revocation and managed session removal
case_matrix.mechanism: Canonical issue/take/session flow. Another store revokes parent and removes sibling session between roots. Child own row remains active but actual parent revocation denies payload; managed put cannot resurrect a revoked session.
Explicit at values before/equal/after expiry within a root; previous time remains readable and both stores' usage statistics remain unchanged. No clock mocking, GC write, or cached expired decision.
Mutating original input and separate returned arrays cannot alter subsequent reads across calls/stores/canonical roots.

Delayed continuation retains its ended ALS and cannot borrow a newer root. Abort denies get and synchronous inspect; swallowed callback refusal still rejects root. Later valid outside-scope read succeeds.
Dispose is started outside the admitted root. New auth reads/inspect fail immediately, admitted root drains, disposal completes and repeated dispose remains safe; other store can still read.

After warm reads, caught put/take/remove/collect/revoke failures still poison canonical readonly root. Other store confirms durable payloads/session/usage unchanged. Local pending revocation intent is not confused with a peer durable commit. Final assertions additionally prove the local pending fence reports revoked/denies payload while the independent peer still sees the unchanged active durable session.

Creates another real closed SQLite DB, preserves original inode only for cleanup, atomically renames replacement to installation path; get/inspect/stats and both warmed stores reject and cannot hot-adopt the new file.
Moves original file aside and installs an alias; all auth entrypoints reject, repeated reads reject, original file restored in finally.

Moves original file away; retained handles cannot return old credentials or silently recreate/adopt a path. Original restored in finally. After all refusals, lstat must still throw ENOENT; auth reads cannot recreate the missing database.

race_and_cleanup: Both entered barriers use Promise.race([entered.promise, reading]); an early root rejection propagates rather than leaving the test waiting for an unreachable barrier.
Every held root/writer/disposal continuation is given a rejection handler, released in finally and awaited before store disposal.
Cross-store writer starts outside the root ALS and is never awaited inside the held root; no impossible external commit during BEGIN IMMEDIATE is assumed.
Physical mutations are confined to fresh temp fixtures; restoration executes before withStores disposes instances and recursively removes only that test directory.
Replacement DB is disposed before rename. No product callback or authority facade is mocked, replaced or instrumented.

selection_and_budget.note: The counts are source syntax, not executed expect totals; helper and loop invocations add runtime assertions.
selection_and_budget.qualification_limit: These controls supplement the five mandatory installed UI journeys; they do not supply any installed-case PASS.

residual_limits: Static review only. Bun/SQLite runtime, implicit statement snapshot reset, lock ordering and disposal behavior require the authorized surgical Actions gate.
The source has no filesystem TOCTOU/ABA proof; it exercises ordinary between-call replacement/alias/removal guards.
Tests assert observable auth state and failures, not connection allocation counts or a measured performance improvement.
Existing Auth72 race controls remain the independent evidence for immediate local pending-revocation/logout before durable write completion.

draft_superseded.final_delta: Final draft adds four local-pending-versus-peer assertions and no-file-recreation assertion; both barrier Promise.race guards retained; no deadline or case selection changed.
